# आचार्य श्री रामसनेही मिश्र | Acharya Shri Ramsanehi Mishra

> Official website of Acharya Shri Ramsanehi Mishra, founder of Vaishnav Vidyapeetham, a gurukul at Vrindavan, India. Disciple of Rajendra Das Ji Maharaj. Bilingual: Hindi (default) and English.

## Pages (Hindi)
- [Home](https://ramsanehimishra.com/): Introduction, upcoming events, gurukul, book
- [जीवन परिचय](https://ramsanehimishra.com/about): Biography, studies and gurus
- [गुरुकुल](https://ramsanehimishra.com/gurukul): Vaishnav Vidyapeetham gurukul, Vrindavan
- [संपर्क](https://ramsanehimishra.com/contact): Contact

## Pages (English)
- [Home](https://ramsanehimishra.com/en)
- [Biography](https://ramsanehimishra.com/en/about)
- [Gurukul](https://ramsanehimishra.com/en/gurukul)
- [Contact](https://ramsanehimishra.com/en/contact)
